No exact record changed, so the artwork approvals still apply. fullValidationReview.note: Full pass over the era with scripts/bulbapedia/sample-review.mjs sm --all (seed 20260301, live TCGdex). Three flags were wrong pairings and are now dropped through exclusions.json (see its reasons): en:SM1:SUN_MOON:93/149 Ribombee (TCGdex SM1S-043 is Kangaskhan, Ribombee is SM1S-042), en:SM2:GUARDIANS_RISING:168/145 and en:SM4:CRIMSON_INVASION:124/111 Basic Energy (the Japanese sets have 61 cards in total, so local id 062 does not exist). Two were a transient TCGdex 503 and cleared on a re-run. Two were a parser artifact: Bulbapedia writes Z-move names with <small> markup, which travelled into the index; stripHtmlTags in bulbapedia-parser.mjs now removes it. The remaining 22 flags are source naming conventions, all with matching card number, set and HP: abbreviated energy names ("Basic Grass Energy" vs "Grass Energy", "Unit Energy LPM" vs "Unit Energy LightningPsychicMetal", "Fairy Charm F" vs "Fairy Charm Fighting"), one variant kanji (地底探検隊 vs 地底探険隊), one kana typo (ブラックマークット for ブラックマーケット) and one HP difference (Ribombee, already excluded). Re-checks after the fixes: SM1->SM1S 71/0, SM2->SM2K 60/0, SM4->SM4A 60/0, SM11->SM10b 54/0.
